question: What did Jesus ask the Pharisees to show that healing on the Sabbath was right?
options: Would you not fast on the Sabbath?
Would you not light a lamp?
Would you not go to the synagogue?
If your child or ox falls into a well on the Sabbath, will you not pull it out?
explanation: Jesus asked, 'If one of you has a child or an ox that falls into a well on the Sabbath day, will you not immediately pull it out?'
